body:
"Spin-off" from #723 

Current requirement (v4.0.1, 2020-04-12):
> V3.3.3 Verify that the application terminates all other active sessions after a successful password change, and that this is effective across the application, federated login (if present), and any relying parties.

Proposal:
V3.3.3 Verify that the application terminates all other active sessions after a successful password change (including change via password recovery), and that this is effective across the application, federated login (if present), and any relying parties.

comments.body: Please review #735 and make the issue title a little more specific

Rather than “does” I suggest “gives the user the option to”. Please don’t make me log into my iPhone again with a big password just because I changed it and know it was me!
